# generated by agentry run — do not edit (codex adapter)
model_provider = "agentry"

approval_policy = "never"
sandbox_mode = "read-only"

multi_agent = false

goals = false

[otel]
exporter = "none"

[tools.experimental_request_user_input]
enabled = false

[skills]
include_instructions = false

[skills.bundled]
enabled = false

[model_providers.agentry]
name = "agentry"
base_url = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false
request_max_retries = 0

[model_providers.agentry.auth]
command = "/bin/cat"
args = ["/run/agentry/model-signin/token"]
timeout_ms = 5000
refresh_interval_ms = 300000

[mcp_servers.gateway]
url = "http://gateway:8811/mcp"
bearer_token_env_var = "MCP_GATEWAY_TOKEN"
default_tools_approval_mode = "approve"
omit_tools_from = ["deferred"]
